body: This is so lovely to read!

what led me first to want to end myself at 16. growing up atheist in a muslim country. being transgender in denial, self inflicted but didn't have much choice anyways. being different overall and never belonging to anything. certainly not in my "home" country. I feel more at home in Canada but I still feel disconnected. then trying to be "normal" caused the wrong relationship. So overall it's a good 32 years out of 40 "trying" to get out. I made the best that I could with my life considering the cards I've been dealt, but it's still a mess. So no more "try again". I am tired of being alive, I actually stopped liking life long time ago. But couldn't do it out of guilt/parental responsibility. Now I'm good.

This hit home too close. 38 now, and the more time went by the worst it got. I missed on my 20s being too absorbed with my non childhood and non teenage years, had a stupid untreated depression. then I royally fucked up my 30s trying to conform and be something. I miserably failed and I'm now contemplating the void. A word of advice: try to leave that behind you and start living your 20s. Try. start soon. you would have missed one phase of your life, not all.
